keyword.en: how to inquire Xingtai for Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump
keyword.zh: 如何向邢台询盘柴油搅拌泵一体机

title.en: Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³ is the Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump cell under “Fan Power Consumption”
title.zh: 「料斗容积 0.4 m³」是「风机 功率消耗」下面的柴油搅拌泵一体机格子

description.en: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump at /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump. Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³ Outlet Pressure 23 MPa
description.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机见 /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump。料斗容积 0.4 m³整机重量 4200 kg

h1.en: Keep Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump under “Fan Efficiency” without new ratings
h1.zh: 在「风机 效率」下保留柴油搅拌泵一体机，不另写额定值

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump. The row to open is /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump. Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa. Main Unit Weight 4200 kg. 40/50 model with 500 mixer. Theoretical Output 25 m³/h. Diesel Engine 4108 / 66–75 kW. 24 mm Stone (H / V) 40 / 120 m. 13 mm Stone (H / V) 60 / 180 m. The printed output cell is 25 m³/h. Series Note 30 model with 400 mixer. Dimensions (L×W×H) 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm. The printed power cell is 4108 / 66–75 kW. Stone Capacity (H / V, ≤ 1 inch) 100 / 300 m. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm and Main Unit Weight is 4200 kg. Theoretical Output is 25 m³/h OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump. The section title “Fan Power Consumption” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是柴油搅拌泵一体机的数字。要打开的行是 /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump。料斗容积 0.4 m³.整机重量 4200 kg.最大出口压力 23 MPa.理论输送量 25 m³/h.已印输送量是 25 m³/h。柴油机 4108 / 66–75 kW.已印动力是 4108 / 66–75 kW。细石输送（水平/垂直） 100 / 300 m.24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 40 / 120 m.13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 / 180 m.外形尺寸 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm.40/50 model with 500 mixer。系列说明 30 model with 400 mixer.运输请抄外形尺寸是 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm，整机重量是 4200 kg。理论输送量是 25 m³/h OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump 开始。节标题「风机 功率消耗」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

body.en: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump is unchanged by the heading “Fan Power Consumption”. Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³. Theoretical Output 25 m³/h. The printed output cell is 25 m³/h. Stone Capacity (H / V, ≤ 1 inch) 100 / 300 m.
body.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机不因标题「风机 功率消耗」而改动。料斗容积 0.4 m³.理论输送量 25 m³/h.已印输送量是 25 m³/h。细石输送（水平/垂直） 100 / 300 m.

body.en: This section is titled “Fan Efficiency”. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump still prints the cells below. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa. Diesel Engine 4108 / 66–75 kW. Series Note 30 model with 400 mixer. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm and Main Unit Weight is 4200 kg.
body.zh: 本节标题是「风机 效率」。柴油搅拌泵一体机下面这些格子仍是印出来的。最大出口压力 23 MPa.柴油机 4108 / 66–75 kW.系列说明 30 model with 400 mixer.运输请抄外形尺寸是 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm，整机重量是 4200 kg。

heading.zh: 功率消耗 - 英制单位

body.en: Under “Power Consumption - Imperial Units”, Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. Main Unit Weight 4200 kg. 24 mm Stone (H / V) 40 / 120 m. Dimensions (L×W×H) 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm. Theoretical Output is 25 m³/h OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump.
body.zh: 在「功率消耗 - 英制单位」下，柴油搅拌泵一体机这一节只放已印出的格子。整机重量 4200 kg.24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 40 / 120 m.外形尺寸 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm.理论输送量是 25 m³/h OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump 开始。

heading.zh: 风机与安装 损失 系统 损失

body.en: “Fan and Installation Loss (System Loss)” titles this part of the Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump note. The figures stay the printed ones. 40/50 model with 500 mixer. 13 mm Stone (H / V) 60 / 180 m. The printed power cell is 4108 / 66–75 kW. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/fans-efficiency-power-consumption-d_197.html.
body.zh: 「风机与安装 损失 系统 损失」是柴油搅拌泵一体机这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。40/50 model with 500 mixer。13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 / 180 m.已印动力是 4108 / 66–75 kW。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/fans-efficiency-power-consumption-d_197.html。

question.en: Does “Fan Power Consumption” replace Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³?
question.zh: 「风机 功率消耗」会替换「料斗容积 0.4 m³」吗？

answer.en: No. Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³ remains the printed wording for Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。料斗容积 0.4 m³仍是柴油搅拌泵一体机已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Outlet Pressure 23 MPa belong on the Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump row?
question.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机这一行里，「整机重量 4200 kg」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Fan Efficiency” add to Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump?
question.zh: 「风机 效率」给柴油搅拌泵一体机增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/fans-efficiency-power-consumption-d_197.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/fans-efficiency-power-consumption-d_197.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Is a list price printed beside Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³?
question.zh: 「料斗容积 0.4 m³」旁边印了标价吗？

alt.en: Fans - Efficiency and Power Consumption. Image from the source page: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/fans-efficiency-power-consumption-d_197.html.
alt.zh: Fans - Efficiency and Power Consumption。图来自来源页：https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/fans-efficiency-power-consumption-d_197.html。
